passages.heading: Day 1 — Notice
passages.text:
money fear lives in your body before it lives in your calendar. Welcome to day one of *Financial Anxiety*. Everything this week is built on a single move — noticing what is already happening inside you before trying to change it.

Most people try to solve money fear with better planning. It doesn't work because money fear is a nervous-system state, not a scheduling problem. Today we locate where in the body it actually sits.

The one-line you'll carry today: **money fear lives in your body before it lives in your calendar.**

Don't try to make this profound. The whole point of a seven-day arc is that small, honest moves — done in a real body on a real Tuesday — outperform any amount of philosophy. Read the practice once, do it once, and let the rest of the day carry it for you.

passages.heading: Day 2 — Breathe
passages.text:
The exhale is the off-switch. Day 2 of *Financial Anxiety*. Today we build directly on what yesterday opened.

1. Sit for 5 minutes with no input. No music. No phone.
2. Watch what the mind does at minute 2 and 4.
3. Do not resolve. Notice.
4. Return to email dispersion refreshed.

passages.heading: Sleep Contract
passages.text:
1. Choose a lights-out time you can hold 5 nights in a row.
2. 60 minutes before: no work, no fast content.
3. 30 minutes before: dim lights.
4. Track it. Sleep is training.

passages.heading: Design The Field
passages.text:
1. Clear one surface entirely.
2. Put one object of intent on it (book, note, image).
3. Remove one visible distraction.
4. Work from this field tomorrow morning.

passages.heading: Stop At 90%
passages.text:
1. In your next work block, set a timer for 25 minutes.
2. Stop when it rings, even if you're mid-sentence.
3. Walk for 5 minutes.
4. Return with fuller attention.
